lines: Brittle and Frostbreak on a Guardian now start when its freeze bar fills and stop when it dies. Before, short fights counted the Guardian as Brittle from the first second, so fast cold builds read too high (up to about 15%). Long fights are unchanged.
Shock, chill and Brittle now add together (the game's own stacking table and Freeze tooltip). Before, only the strongest of them counted.
A Brittle Guardian takes 10% more damage from every skill's hits for the 5.5 s after its freeze bar fills, not only with Frostbreak.
Chill is now 10% to 30% by the size of your cold hit against the enemy's life (game log), so cold skills deal more on rares.
Increased freeze duration (Stormfrost and others) fills a Guardian's freeze bar faster (game log, 20 Nov).
A Guardian's freeze bar no longer fills when your cold hits land more than 6 s apart. Crack now counts on unique enemies too.

Skill tree: when the picked skill is cast by Cast on Crit, the note under the tree says the source skill's crit chance and attack or cast speed count toward its DPS. When the picked skill holds Cast on Crit, the note says the spell it casts is not counted, with a button to count it too.
Runes on shields and tomes now give their armour-side lines (as on body armour), not the weapon line. Builds with runes in an off-hand shield or tome see their numbers change.
Riven Atlas: new search box (node name or effect); matching nodes get a red ring.
Riven Atlas: clicking a node also takes the nodes before it, and when you run out of points the Rupture Level, then the Riven Tier, goes up to pay for it instead of showing a warning.
Gear Sim: a warning when your rare or magic items have no stat lines (gear from a game build code), since they then count as bare bases.
Database: sort by drop weight (rarest first or commonest first) on Uniques, Item mods, Item bases and All. Cards show their weight while that sort is on.

Guardian life now follows the game's own numbers from its log (target fight time x the game's model DPS x the Deep's life multiplier). This changes shock size, the freeze bar and Kindling a little at most Rupture levels.
FAQ: new Guardian life table on Guardian Fights; The Deep now shows the game's real life and damage multipliers (life x214 at Rupture 150, not x7.9).
FAQ: the Ailments page also shows how ailment damage adds and multiplies; Herald kill effects moved from Drop Chances to Damage Multipliers; number tables no longer have uneven gaps.
Riven Atlas: the Character, Passive tree, Skills and Damage tabs now show above the atlas, so you can leave it again.
New Riven Atlas tab in the Build Planner: plan your Atlas points (drops, experience and monsters; it does not change your damage).
Database: Primal uniques show their Primal tag next to the name, so they are easy to tell apart from the normal unique of the same name.
Database: hover a unique's tag (Signature, Chase, Core, Primal, Limited) to see what it means. Primal items now list all the places they drop from.
Save Creator: the steps no longer say to close the game (only the character must not be logged in), and the offline-only notice and all four steps are translated.
Save Creator: a notice that it is for offline characters only, and a save is now also refused when it carries an online id.

Save Creator: it now remembers the last offline save you picked for each class (kept in this browser only). Paste a build code and it goes onto the remembered save of its class, without picking the file again.

Save Creator: gear and idols are shown like the Character tab, and the bag like the game's own window with the pouch row. Click an empty gear slot, Fossil cell, bag cell or pouch place to add an item there; items open in the same item window as the Character tab.
Save Creator: drag idols and bag items to move them, drop one on an item of the same size to trade places, hold Ctrl to copy an idol. Jewels show their gem.
Save Creator fixes: the bag is 12 cells wide (the page took it as 9), the Dwarven Fossil takes its 2x2 cells so a new item no longer lands on it, and Base Grade is now written to the save.
Dragonling, Cold Heart: Hoarfrost Dive now counts its 50% more on a Guardian that is Frozen, Brittle or past half its freeze bar (from the node text and the game's data, not yet checked in game).
Mana on kill and movement speed on kill are no longer listed as "not modelled".
Gear Sim: Oathwords it recommends now show Craftable when you have the runes in your saves.
FAQ, Forge & Crafting: Gloomsilver is a rare find since patch 84; the Oath Broker sells 5 a day for gold; Lightless Anneal costs 3 Gloomsilver.
Support picker: supports that change nothing for the selected skill now sit in their own "No effect in the sim" group; they can still be socketed.
